1: Nabi ﷺ ke chacha Abu Lahab bin Abdul Muttalib ke dono hath barbaad ho gaye, kyunke us ke tamam aamaal barbaad ho gaye; woh Nabi ﷺ ko takleef pohanchata tha. Us ki tamam koshishein bekaar gayin.
2: Us ka maal aur us ki aulad us ke kis kaam aa sakti hai? Na woh us ko azaab se bacha sakte hain, na us ke liye koi rehmat la sakte hain.
3: Qayamat ke din woh bahut jald bharakti hui aag mein daakhil hoga aur us ki garmi bardasht karega.
4: Aur us ki biwi Umm Jameel bhi us mein daakhil hogi, jo Nabi ﷺ ke raaste mein kaante daal kar unhein takleef pohanchati thi.
5: Us ki gardan mein ek rassi kas kar bandhi jayegi, jis se us ko jahannum mein ghaseeta jayega.
